name: NVDA vs AMD: Price Action, Relative Performance & Correlation
description: Research study comparing NVDA and AMD across five dimensions: (1) normalized price performance indexed to 100 at start, (2) rolling 60-day return correlation, (3) rolling 1-year return spread with dual-color area fill showing which stock is outperforming, (4) daily returns scatter plot with OLS trend line, and (5) summary statistics table with total return, annualized volatility, Sharpe ratio, max drawdown, and full-period correlation.
source:
# =============================================================================
# NVDA vs AMD: Price Action, Relative Performance & Correlation
# =============================================================================
# Compares NVDA and AMD across:
#   1. Normalized price performance (indexed to 100)
#   2. Rolling 60-day return correlation
#   3. Rolling 1-year return spread (NVDA minus AMD, dual-color area)
#   4. Daily returns scatter with OLS regression line
#   5. Summary statistics table (return, vol, Sharpe, max DD, correlation)
#
# NVDA is the primary asset; AMD is loaded via reference_stocks.
# All charts render on NVDA's dashboard page for a unified view.
# =============================================================================

# --- Data Sources ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
nvda = ffill(src.c)

amd_o, amd_h, amd_l, amd_c, amd_v, amd_vw, amd_n = reference_stocks(ticker='AMD')()
amd = ffill(amd_c)

bar_ts = index()

# --- Daily Returns ---
nvda_ret = returns(period=1)(nvda)
amd_ret = returns(period=1)(amd)

# --- Normalized Prices (indexed to 100 at start) ---
nvda_first = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.First)(nvda)
amd_first = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.First)(amd)
nvda_norm = nvda / nvda_first * 100
amd_norm = amd / amd_first * 100

# --- Rolling 60-Day Return Correlation ---
corr_60d = rolling_corr(window=60)(nvda_ret, amd_ret)

# --- Full-Period Expanding Correlation (for summary table) ---
full_corr = rolling_corr(window_type=WindowType.expanding)(nvda_ret, amd_ret)

# --- Rolling 1-Year (252-day) Return Spread ---
nvda_1y = (nvda - (nvda >> 252)) / (nvda >> 252)
amd_1y = (amd - (amd >> 252)) / (amd >> 252)
spread = nvda_1y - amd_1y

# Split into positive (NVDA outperforming) and negative (AMD outperforming)
spread_pos = spread if spread > 0 else 0.0 / 0.0
spread_neg = spread if spread < 0 else 0.0 / 0.0

# --- Annualized Volatility (252-day rolling, use Last for summary) ---
nvda_vol = volatility(period=252)(nvda)
amd_vol = volatility(period=252)(amd)

# --- Sharpe Ratio (expanding, annualized) ---
nvda_mean_ret = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(nvda_ret)
nvda_std_ret = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Std)(nvda_ret)
nvda_sharpe = nvda_mean_ret / nvda_std_ret * sqrt(252)

amd_mean_ret = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(amd_ret)
amd_std_ret = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Std)(amd_ret)
amd_sharpe = amd_mean_ret / amd_std_ret * sqrt(252)

# --- Max Drawdown ---
nvda_peak = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(nvda)
nvda_dd = (nvda - nvda_peak) / nvda_peak
nvda_max_dd = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(nvda_dd)

amd_peak = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(amd)
amd_dd = (amd - amd_peak) / amd_peak
amd_max_dd = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(amd_dd)

# --- Full-Period Return ---
nvda_total_ret = (nvda - nvda_first) / nvda_first
amd_total_ret = (amd - amd_first) / amd_first

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: Normalized Price Performance
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Indexed Price Performance (Base = 100)',
    category='1. Price Performance',
    y_axis_label='Indexed Price',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='NVDA', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='AMD', color=Color.Sky)
    ]),
    order=1
)(bar_ts, nvda_norm, amd_norm)

# =============================================================================
# CHART 2: Rolling 60-Day Return Correlation
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Rolling 60-Day Return Correlation',
    category='2. Correlation Analysis',
    y_axis_label='Pearson Correlation',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='0'),
        ReferenceLine(value=1, color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Perfect +1')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='60d Correlation', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=2
)(bar_ts, corr_60d)

# =============================================================================
# CHART 3: Rolling 1-Year Return Spread (NVDA minus AMD)
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Rolling 1-Year Return Spread: NVDA minus AMD',
    category='3. Relative Performance',
    area=True,
    y_axis_label='1Y Return Spread',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid, title='0%')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='NVDA Outperforming', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='AMD Outperforming', color=Color.Slate)
    ]),
    order=3
)(bar_ts, spread_pos, spread_neg)

# =============================================================================
# CHART 4: Daily Returns Scatter (NVDA vs AMD)
# =============================================================================
xy_scatter(
    title='Daily Returns: NVDA vs AMD',
    category='4. Returns Scatter',
    x_axis_label='NVDA Daily Return',
    y_axis_label='AMD Daily Return',
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=1,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    show_trend_line=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='0%')
    ]),
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='Daily Returns', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker)
    ]),
    order=4
)(nvda_ret, amd_ret)

# =============================================================================
# TABLE: Summary Statistics
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='NVDA vs AMD Summary Statistics',
        row_size=5,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Total Return', 'Ann. Volatility', 'Sharpe Ratio', 'Max Drawdown', 'Correlation'],
        col_headers=['NVDA', 'AMD'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='5. Summary Statistics',
    order=5
)(nvda_total_ret, amd_total_ret, nvda_vol, amd_vol, nvda_sharpe, amd_sharpe, nvda_max_dd, amd_max_dd, full_corr, full_corr)
